ModMetaData.name: Devil May Cry Weapons
ModMetaData.author: AIvanCP
ModMetaData.description:
Twenty-one devil arms from Devil May Cry 3, 4 and 5, dragged onto the rim. No DLL, no Harmony - every effect below is stock RimWorld XML.
THE ARSENAL
Devil swords: Rebellion, Force Edge, Sparda, Yamato, Mirage Edge, Devil Sword Dante, Devil Sword Vergil, Red Queen, Agni & Rudra, Nevan Gauntlets: Beowulf, Balrog, Gilgamesh, King Cerberus Heavy: Cavaliere Firearms: Ebony & Ivory, Blue Rose, Coyote-A, Kalina Ann, Artemis, Spiral
EVERY WEAPON DOES SOMETHING
Elemental hits are real damage instances with their own chance to land, each carrying a debuff that sticks to the target:
• Demonic fire (Red Queen, Balrog, Devil Sword Dante, Agni, Sparda) - burns that keep burning, and can set the ground alight • Demonic ice (King Cerberus) - slows movement and stiffens the hands • Demonic lightning (King Cerberus, Nevan) - a real stun, with adaptation so it cannot be chain-locked • Holy light (Beowulf, Sparda, Force Edge, Artemis) - sears the eyes; the target cannot aim • Dimensional cut (Yamato, Mirage Edge, Devil Sword Vergil) - bypasses armour outright and opens a wound that will not clot • Demonic wind (Rudra) - wide sweeps that catch several targets at once • Soul drain (Nevan) - takes the strength, leaves the body • Shred (Cavaliere) - heavy bleeding that needs tending • Stagger (Gilgamesh, Coyote-A, Ebony & Ivory, Blue Rose) - concussive force, no wound
Yamato, Mirage Edge, Rebellion and Devil Sword Vergil also land a much harder hit on a target that has not noticed the attacker.
ACQUISITION
Three research tiers gate the whole arsenal, and every weapon's crafting recipe is actually locked behind one of them. Otherwise: a legendary weapon collector who arrives by orbital ship or with an outlander caravan, or as a quest reward.
No raider, mercenary, tribal or Empire pawn will ever spawn carrying one of these.
